title: HIV Self-Test Protocol
author: Unknown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.izscf6e

steps.title: Perform Exacto® Test HIV
steps.instruction: Execute the HIV self-test using the Exacto® Test HIV (Biosynex) cassette.

substeps.instruction: Place one drop of fingertip blood into the SQUARE well BLOOD of the test cassette using the sampler stick.
Add two drops of diluent into the ROUND wells DILUENT of the test cassette.
Wait 10 minutes before reading the results.

steps.title: Perform Alere Determine™ HIV-1/2 Test
steps.instruction: Execute the HIV-1/2 test using the Alere Determine™ (Alere Medical Co. Ltd.) kit.

substeps.instruction: Apply 50 μL of whole blood to the sample pad using a precision pipette.
Wait one minute, then apply one drop of Chase Buffer to the sample pad.
Wait 15 minutes before reading the results.

steps.title: Perform Uni-Gold™ HIV Test
steps.instruction: Execute the Uni-Gold™ HIV-1/2 assay (Trinity Biotech Manufacturing Ltd.).

substeps.instruction: Remove controls from 2-8°C storage and allow them to reach room temperature.
Mix the contents of the vials by gentle swirling or inversion.
Apply 50 μL of whole blood to the assay using a precision pipette.
Wait 20 minutes before reading the results.

steps.title: Perform recomLine HIV 1 & HIV 2 IgG Assay
steps.instruction: Execute the recomLine HIV 1 & HIV 2 IgG (Biosynex, France) assay including washing, conjugation, and substrate reaction.

substeps.instruction: Remove the plastic cover from the incubation trays.
Siphon serum dilution from individual wells.
Pipette 2 ml of ready-to-use wash buffer into each well, shake gently for 5 minutes, and siphon off the buffer.
Add 2 ml of ready-to-use conjugate solution and incubate for 45 minutes with gentle shaking.
Add 1.5 ml of ready-to-use substrate solution and incubate for 8 minutes while shaking gently.
Stop the reaction by washing at least three times briefly with deionised water.
Dry the strips between 2 layers of absorbent paper for 2 hours prior to analysis.

steps.title: Perform Amplix® HIV-1 Viral Load Quantification
steps.instruction: Quantify HIV-1 RNA targeting gag and LTR genes using the Amplix® (Strasbourg, France) system.

substeps.instruction: Extract nucleic acids using the Amplix® viral extraction kit (Biosynex), eluting in 50 µl of elution buffer (90 minutes per run).
Combine 50 µl of eluate with lyophilized PCR reagents to constitute a premix mixture.

steps.title: Perform Abbott RealTime HIV-1 Assay
steps.instruction: Execute the Abbott RealTime HIV-1 assay (Abbott Molecular Inc, IL, USA) targeting the pol integrase region of the HIV-1 genome.

substeps.instruction: Use 0.6 mL of plasma volume for the assay protocol.
